pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 4.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: SHORT STORY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What should one look for when reading a story?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the characters in a short story
2. use contextual clues to infer character traits of the characters in a short story

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 4.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: SHORT STORY
This lesson teaches Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the characters in a short story
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use contextual clues to infer character traits of the characters in a short story
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story above.
2. Explain Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What should one look for when reading a story?
2. What qualities do you admire in people?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the characters in a short story
2. use contextual clues to infer character traits of the characters in a short story

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
